beforeMethodText:
function GameMechanics:PositionSelectedEgg(manager, record, frame, token)
	local c = self.LocalFeatureController
	local active = c and c.Scheduler and c.Scheduler.Active
	local function owns()
		return c and c.State == "RUNNING" and manager == c.EggTravel and c.Scheduler.Active == active and active
			and active.Definition.Owner == "EGG_TRAVEL" and active.Definition.Generation == c.Generation and active.Token == token
	end
	if not owns() then return false, "Selected-egg task does not own the scheduler" end
	if not self.Config.EGG_TRAVEL_SETTINGS.ENABLE_DIRECT_POSITIONING then return false, "Direct egg positioning disabled" end
	local fresh, reason = manager:Validate(record, token)
	if not fresh then return false, reason end
	local allowed, blocker = self:LocalFeatureGuard()
	if not allowed then return false, blocker end
	fresh, reason = manager:Validate(record, token)
	if not fresh then return false, reason end
	if fresh.NeedsNativeTravel then return false, "Correct unlocked native area must be reached first" end
	if fresh.InRange then return true, fresh.LocationOnly and "Already inside diagnostic physical arrival radius; no direct positioning needed"
		or "Already in observed native hatch range; no direct positioning needed" end
	local clearedFrame, clearanceReason = manager:ResolveStanding(fresh)
	if not clearedFrame then return false, clearanceReason end
	if typeof(frame) ~= "CFrame" or (frame.Position - clearedFrame.Position).Magnitude > 0.25 then return false, "Standing geometry changed during guards; explicit rearm required" end
	frame = clearedFrame -- Assign exactly the freshly cleared avatar orientation/volume.
	if typeof(frame) ~= "CFrame" or not featureFinite(frame.Position.X) or not featureFinite(frame.Position.Y)
		or not featureFinite(frame.Position.Z) or not fresh.RangeOrigin
		or (frame.Position - fresh.RangeOrigin.Position).Magnitude > fresh.Range
		or not manager:RangeEligibleAt(fresh, frame.Position, true) then return false, fresh.LocationOnly
			and "Validated standing transform unavailable or outside verified physical arrival radius"
			or "Validated standing transform unavailable or outside actual native hatch eligibility" end
	if self.LastEggPositionLease == record.LeaseId then return false, "Direct position already attempted for this lease" end
	local final, finalReason = manager:Validate(record, token, true)
	if not final or final.CharacterRoot ~= fresh.CharacterRoot or final.NeedsNativeTravel then return false, finalReason or "Selected egg/character/area changed during final positioning guards" end
	if token:CheckCancelled() or not owns() or not self.Config.EGG_TRAVEL_SETTINGS.ENABLE_DIRECT_POSITIONING then return false, "Cancelled or selected-egg scheduler ownership changed" end
	if final.InRange then return true, final.LocationOnly and "Already inside diagnostic physical arrival radius after guards; no assignment"
		or "Already in observed native hatch range after guards; no assignment" end
	self.LastEggPositionLease = record.LeaseId -- Mark before assignment; failure cannot trigger repeated snapping.
	local assigned, err = pcall(function() fresh.CharacterRoot.CFrame = frame end)
	return assigned, assigned and "Direct CFrame assigned; observed arrival/stability/range still pending" or "Direct position failed: " .. tostring(err)
end

exactScope: Four added lines exclusively in PositionSelectedEgg: observe full standing geometry again after existing final destination/access validation and final cancellation/ownership/config/in-range guards; fail if unavailable or full CFrame differs from the previously cleared selected frame; repeat the existing pure cancellation/ownership/config guard after recheck. Never adopt returned replacement transform.
preserved: All original guards and ordering remain intact. Existing first-standing frame update/tolerance remains unchanged. Destination Instance and account/lease/token checks, range, assignment, lease consumption, one-attempt and arrival/stability logic are unchanged. No retry/recovery or gameplay authority added.
deliberateStrictness: Final equality compares the whole CFrame value, including position and orientation, without tolerance. Even small observed jitter can conservatively require explicit rearm. It never silently switches landing point or orientation.
yieldingBoundary: Final Validate may enter native/dependency readers before returning; its changes are covered by the subsequent full ResolveStanding. ResolveStanding can call RangeEligibleAt before final footprint/clearance observations; TRAVEL_ONLY uses the immediate physical-range branch. After ResolveStanding returns, the existing TaskScheduler token CheckCancelled reads only self.Cancelled; owns and direct-positioning configuration checks are pure reads. No explicit wait, native/dependency call or destination validation occurs before the unchanged pcall CFrame assignment.
queryBound: One additional existing ResolveStanding call; at most nine same-radius candidate rays and associated range/support/clearance observations. No additional positioning attempt, movement loop, retry, recovery or snap.
nonAtomicLimit: The Workspace observations and HRP assignment are not an engine transaction. A world change after the last observation, replication/physics interference, or later server correction cannot be ruled out. Existing stable-arrival verification is still required; this proposal is not an absolute support guarantee.
actionPermissions: All hatch, equipment, purchase, pickup, farming and spending authority OFF. Proposal and offline tests only. Separate owner approval required before applying protected adapter change; no publication of local movement candidate.
